The '''Markresh Slaver's Consortium''' was a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] organization relatively new to the business during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They specialized in the sale of adolescent [[Yaka]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]].
